'''Alet Komain''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Daimar]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He later became its [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and represented it in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Biography==
Komain was born on [[Daimar]] into a poor family and in about [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], he was drafted into Daimar's military, to fight in the [[Trade Conflicts]]. He quickly rose through the ranks and after years of success as a military leader, [[King/Legends|King]] [[Mitar]], the monarch of Daimar, appointed Komain to become a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and represent Daimar in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] capital world. When [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] replaced [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] of the Republic, Komain hoped that this would end all the bickering that took place in the senate. However, his hope for a better senate was shattered in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], when Palpatine declared himself [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] and reformed the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Komain returned to Daimar, who refused to cooperate with Palpatine's [[New Order/Legends|New Order]].<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />

The Empire began a [[Blockade of Daimar|blockade]] of Daimar, bringing the planet close to surrender. With defeat imminent, Mitar ordered Komain and some other important figures to flee the the planet [[Byrsym]], where Mitar's son [[Torrin]] was leading an anti-Imperial resistance group, so that they wouldn't fall into Imperial hands. Komain and the others were able to breech to blockade and travel to Byrsym, where they successfully found and joined forces with Torrin.<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />

==Personality and traits==
Komain had a lot of admiration for his father. As a soldier, he demonstrated that he was a skilled tactician and quick to act, enabling him to rise through the ranks. As a senator, he acted on his conscience and had an impeccable reputation among the other senators. However, he disliked the bickering and pettiness of the other senators, so wasn't popular among them. Following the formation of the Galactic Empire, he was disgusted that many worlds had accepted Palpatine's rule. He disliked being ordered to leave Daimar, but did not question the order, as he had great respect for Mitar and the monarchy.<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />

Komain was bilingual and could speak both [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] and [[Rodese/Legends|Rodese]], the [[Language/Legends|language]] spoken by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. He also weighed 105 kilograms.<ref name="Flames of Rebellion" />
